description: This file contains utility functions for generating documentation links and rendering related content for Playwright API documentation, including functions to create markdown links for classes and members, renderer factory for different languages, and URL path helpers.

methods.name: createMarkdownLink
methods.description: Generates a markdown link to a class member documentation page, constructing the URL hash based on member type and name.

methods.name: createClassMarkdownLink
methods.description: Creates a markdown link to a class documentation page.

methods.name: docsLinkRendererForLanguage
methods.description: Returns a renderer function that generates markdown links for class members based on language and output type.

methods.name: languageToRelativeDocsPath
methods.description: Maps programming language identifiers to relative documentation URL paths.

methods.name: formatClassName
methods.description: Formats class names for assertions based on the target programming language.

methods.name: assertionArgument
methods.description: Provides the argument name for assertion classes based on class name.

methods.name: renderJSSignature
methods.description: Renders a JavaScript function signature string from an array of argument metadata.

methods.name: renderPlaywrightDevLinks
methods.description: Replaces markdown links in content with URLs pointing to the Playwright documentation site.
